programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: The Enterprise crew investigates the disappearance of a ship's crew on a planet that is a modern version of the Roman Empire.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: Kirk must decide whether to thwart or help a traveller from the future sent back to 1960s Earth on a secret mission.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: The crew of the Enterprise pursues a mysterious woman who has abducted Spock's brain.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: Captain Kirk becomes increasingly erratic and orders the Enterprise into Romulan space. Here, the ship is captured by a beautiful Romulan commander.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A fifteen-year-old boy dies from a mysterious gunshot wound to the head while sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models and the latest in forensic animation are used to find the cause.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting and discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered — but how?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Southside Strangler
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer was identified as the man who raped and strangled five young women in Virginia. With the use of DNA profiling, an innocent man is freed and the real killer is convicted.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Legionnaires' Disease
programme.desc: After a Philadelphia Convention, 180 Legionnaires contract pneumonia-like symptoms and 29 of them die. The determination of one scientist helps identify the cause of this deadly disease.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Dirty Deed
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, Eileen and Derrick Severs disappear from their home in a small village in Great Britain and police find evidence of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Fog
programme.desc: It was the single most deadly automobile accident in American history. Almost a hundred vehicles were involved, twelve people died and more than fifty people were injured. And it happened along a stretch of highway long known for dense, thick fog.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bullet With My Name On It
programme.desc: In his first year on the force, rookie patrol officer Joe Kenda quickly learns the ropes. But when he tries to singlehandedly stop a brawling mob, he finds himself facing down gunfire.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: When the Music Stops
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran Charles Walker is found unconscious, after a stabbing attack so savage even 45 units of blood couldn’t save his life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Animal Nature
programme.desc: When a young woman is found mysteriously slaughtered on the steps of a trailer, Kenda and the homicide team must track down the vile perpetrators that are responsible

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Monster Awakes
programme.desc: When Julie Smith reports being sexually assaulted, Lt. Joe Kenda and his Sex Crimes Unit discover a terrifying similarity to other attacks on the east side of town.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Metal on Metal
programme.desc: A athlete is gunned down just weeks before starting college, leaving family heartbroken and detectives stumped. The man seems an unlikely target, until Lt. Joe Kenda pries into his personal life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Second Case
programme.desc: A woman’s mangled body is found beside a lonely stretch of highway. When the coroner suspects foul play, Kenda is called in to solve the second homicide case of his career.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Ghosts of Mississippi
programme.desc: A report on a string of unsolved homicides in Columbus, Mississippi. Five elderly residents, all living within a mile of each other, were killed within 18 months. Police say, a terrified community believes a serial killer is on the loose.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Conned to Death
programme.desc: The death of Michele MacNeill, and how her family, determined to get justice for her, led investigators to finally uncover the incredible circumstances surrounding her murder.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Terror on Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Terror on Thanksgiving follows the police and forensics investigation that solves the heartrending murder of Kelsey Berreth.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Murder of Susannah Chase
programme.desc: The Murder of Susannah Chase follows the investigation into Susannah’s murder, and how law enforcement and forensics eventually tracked down her killer after more than two decades.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Hitchhike Horror
programme.desc: Hitchhike Horror is the story of Jeannie Moore, the almost 40 year investigation into her murder and how it became the first case in Colorado to be solved with a revolutionary forensics technique.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Rubbermaid Box
programme.desc: The Rubbermaid Box is the story of Carolyn Jansen, the mysterious circumstances surrounding her murder and how cutting-edge forensics and dedicated investigators eventually caught-up with her killer.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-galan

programme.title: iCarly: Matfajten

programme.title: iCarly: Jag vill ha min rektor

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Priscillia Ciatti Case

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 303

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 505
programme.desc: Innan jul år 2000 utsätts Nationalmuseum för landets största konstkupp någonsin. Konstverk till ett värde av 370 miljoner kronor, försvinner. Nu måste polisen använda udda metoder för att lösa fallet.

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 101

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: En 21-årig teaterstudent kliver ur en bil i södra Tyskland och hävdar för tysk polis att han kidnappats och sedan tvingats mörda sin vän och hyresvärd. Men är hans version av historien verkligen sann? (Del 2)

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 701
programme.desc: I september 2020, hittas Erik Fasth livlös i en pöl av blod utanför rummet till den funktionsförhindrade kvinnan han är assistent åt. Polisen börjar genast utreda varför han utsatts för detta hiskeliga brott.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 401
programme.desc: Våren 2017 anmäls Therese Palmkvist försvunnen. Först vid polisens tredje besök i hennes hus nås ett genombrott, och polisen får syn på några röda hårtestar som sticker fram bakom en vedstapel.

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Kopparstölder sker mitt framför allmänhetens ögon i Göteborg, och nya spår efter mordet på 19-åriga William har kommit fram. Vi får även höra om hjältedåden som är nominerade till Civilkuragepriset.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Vi får se en övervakningsfilm från ett par av de rån som en liga misstänks ligga bakom i Landskrona. Efterlyst tar också upp nya uppgifter i 200 sekunders granskning av det 22 år gamla Knutbyfallet.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Flera fall av stölder tas upp, allt från lyxväskor och bilstrålkastare till kupper mot byggvaruhus. Vinnaren av Civilkuragepriset, som delas ut i samarbete med Stiftelsen Tryggare Sverige, ska koras.

programme.title: Efterlyst

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police
programme.desc: In Ukraine and Lithuania, Nazi invaders were welcomed as liberators. In Lithuania, Antanas Gecas led a militia that executed hundreds of Jews. Ukrainian nationalists participated in pogroms slaughtering 34,000 Jews in two days.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.
